query: SELECT TOP 4000 b.oid,b.main_id,b.ra,b.dec,b.otype,b.morph_type,b.morph_bibcode,b.galdim_majaxis,b.galdim_minaxis,b.galdim_angle,b.galdim_bibcode,b.rvz_redshift,b.rvz_radvel,b.rvz_bibcode,f.B,f.V,f.K,b.rvz_nature,b.rvz_qual,b.rvz_err,b.galdim_qual FROM basic AS b JOIN allfluxes AS f ON b.oid=f.oidref WHERE b.otype='G' AND b.rvz_redshift>=0.01 AND b.rvz_redshift<=0.1 AND b.galdim_majaxis>0 AND b.galdim_minaxis>0 AND b.galdim_angle IS NOT NULL AND b.morph_type IS NOT NULL AND f.B IS NOT NULL AND f.K IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rvz_redshift,oid
